entities.name: Indomethacin
observations: A nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug used for heterotopic ossification prophylaxis after acetabular fracture surgery; prolonged postoperative use can impair fracture healing.

entities.name: Indomethacin nonunion risk
observations: A 6-week postoperative indomethacin regimen for heterotopic ossification prophylaxis is associated with increased nonunion risk in an associated long-bone fracture context.

entities.name: Femoral shaft fracture
observations: The clinical scenario includes a surgically treated closed femoral shaft fracture, for which prolonged NSAID exposure may adversely affect union.
